for mode in ['PortfolioTests','CapacityTests','HeadroomTests','WeekendTests','LeverageTests','BtcProfileTests','SevenDayTests']:
 out=r/'legacy_validation'/mode;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 files=list((w/'source').rglob('*.cs'))+[w/'tests/Global.cs']+list((ref/'v4_work/validation'/mode).glob('*.cs'))

 (out/'Tests.runtimeconfig.json').write_text(json.dumps({'runtimeOptions':{'tfm':'net8.0','framework':{'name':'Microsoft.NETCore.App','version':'8.0.32'}}}))
 cmd=[str(r.parent/'dotnet/dotnet'),str(out/'Tests.dll')]

r4_research/run_priority.py.content:
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,time,importlib.util,shutil,hashlib,subprocess
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;W=P.parent;R=W/'r4_priority'
R.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def put(p,x):
    t=p.with_suffix(p.suffix+'.tmp');t.write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)+'\n');t.replace(p)
def load(p):return json.loads(p.read_text())
profile=next(x for x in load(P/'PROFILES.json') if x['PortfolioCapPct']==15)
put(R/(profile['Id']+'.json'),[profile])
for name in ['fresh_xau_tape.json','fresh_eur_tape.json']:
    dest=R/name
    if not dest.exists():dest.symlink_to(W/'buffer_growth'/name)
for name in ['FROZEN_BUFFER_LOCK.json','audit_growth.py']:shutil.copy2(P/name,R/name)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('r4_priority_replay_helper',W/'r3_research/run_r3.py');runner=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(runner)
runner.ROOT=R;runner.BIN=P/'work_r4/replay/Replay.dll';runner.EXPECTED=load(P/'BUILD.json')['binary_sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256(runner.BIN.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==runner.EXPECTED
put(R/'STATUS.json',{'stage':'priority_cap15_B2_running','valid_score':False,'default_parity_required':True,'created_jakarta':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Jakarta')).isoformat()})
runner.replay([profile],'B_COST2',2,'B')
origin=R/'B_COST2';metrics=load(origin/'RUN.json.metrics.json');assert len(metrics)==1
raw=origin/(profile['Id']+'_B_cost2.json.gz');assert raw.exists()
# Precompute one already-declared grid cell. Install only before primary replay starts.
# Even if primary starts in this small window, it begins with cap17.5; no cap15
# writer exists yet. A late cache miss can cause duplicate compute, never a second
# counted grid cell. Preserve the priority job's separate provenance.
dest=P/'SCREEN_B_C2';job=dest/'JOB.json';installed=False
if not job.exists():
    dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True);target=dest/raw.name;tmp=target.with_suffix('.tmp');shutil.copy2(raw,tmp);tmp.replace(target)
    shutil.copy2(origin/'JOB.json',dest/'PRECOMPUTED_CAP15_JOB.json')
    row=dict(metrics[0],File=str(target));put(dest/'RUN.json.metrics.json',[row]);installed=True
put(R/'STATUS.json',{'stage':'awaiting_default_parity','valid_score':False,'primary_cache_installed':installed})
while not (P/'DEFAULT_PARITY.json').exists():
    state=load(P/'STATUS.json')
    if state.get('stage')=='error':raise RuntimeError('Primary control failed; do not score priority report')
    time.sleep(15)
assert load(P/'DEFAULT_PARITY.json')['pass'],'Primary default parity failed; priority result is invalid'
with (R/'audit.log').open('w') as log:subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(R/'audit_growth.py')],stdout=log,stderr=log,check=True)
rows=load(R/'RESULTS.json');assert len(rows)==1 and rows[0]['pass']
x=rows[0];base=next(a for a in load(W/'r3_restore/r2/buffer_growth/RESULTS.json') if a['id']=='BUFFER_EUR_BTC_V2_CANDIDATE' and a['way']=='B' and a['cost']==2)
result={'id':profile['Id'],'way':'B','cost':2,'balance':x['balance'],'dd':x['dd'],'audit':True,'default_parity_pass':True,'scenario_DD_below60':x['dd']<60,'delta_balance_vs_R2':x['balance']-base['balance'],'delta_DD_vs_R2_pp':x['dd']-base['dd'],'full_six_complete':False,'primary_cache_installed':installed,'raw_sha256':x['sha256']}
put(R/'PRELIMINARY_RESULT.json',result);put(R/'STATUS.json',{'stage':'audited_priority_result_ready','valid_score':True,'full_six_complete':False})
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2),flush=True)
